faq.item_0_answer:
Decentraland is a community-driven virtual world where you can connect, explore, and create. Built on the Unity engine, Decentraland streams and renders a vast, continuous environment filled with diverse, user-generated content. As you explore this immersive landscape, you encounter new creations daily, from games and puzzles to scenes and artworks, all crafted by Decentraland's vibrant community of creators.

Decentraland goes beyond traditional gaming experiences. In Decentraland, you can attend live music events, conferences, exhibitions, dance parties, and more.

Your New Friends Are Waiting -- Download Decentraland today and jump in!
faq.item_1_answer:
Step 1: Download and Install the Client
First you will need to install the client, go to Decentraland and click download.

Step 2: Create your Account
When you enter Decentraland, you can use a standard web3 wallet such as Metamask, or log in with a Social account (Google, Discord, X, or Apple).

Step 3: Customize Your Avatar
Once you enter Decentraland you'll first be asked to customize your avatar.

Step 4: Explore!
After completing a quick tutorial, Decentraland is yours to explore!

Step 5: Have fun!
Walk around, talk to others via the chat box, and pop into some events!
faq.item_2_question: Do I need cryptocurrency or a digital wallet to use Decentraland?
faq.item_2_answer:
You do not need to own cryptocurrency to enjoy Decentraland as it is free to use. If you decide to purchase a community-made creation from the Marketplace, there are multiple payment options available, such as credit/debit card and bank transfer in addition to various cryptocurrencies.

As for owning a digital wallet, if you don't already have one, you don't need to get one yourself. When you sign in to Decentraland for the first time, a digital wallet will be created for you behind the scenes if you choose to use a Social account.
faq.item_3_question: How do I become a Decentraland Creator?
faq.item_3_answer:
Decentraland is a world created by its users, meaning you can be a creator of everything from Wearables, Emotes, entire scenes with buildings and/or landscapes, interactive experiences, and games.

Most Wearable and Emote designers use Blender to design their creations. Once complete, items are submitted for publishing in the Marketplace.

You can also download the Creator Hub which combines all of the ease of use of the Web Editor with the power of writing code.
faq.item_4_answer: Costing just 100 MANA, the currency of Decentraland, a Decentraland NAME is essentially a unique and personalized username for your avatar that represents your virtual identity within the Decentraland ecosystem. Getting a Decentraland NAME comes with the added bonus of granting the owner their own World.
faq.item_5_question: What is the difference between LANDs and Worlds?
faq.item_5_answer:
Currently, Worlds can only admit up to 100 visitors at a time and scenes are limited to 100MB whereas LAND parcels have no such limitations. If you would like to build large scenes or host big events, buying or renting LAND will be a better option.

Scenes deployed on LANDs in Genesis City are also more easily discovered by users as they don't need to know your NAME to visit.
faq.item_6_question: How can I get help and contact the Support Team?
faq.item_6_answer: You can contact the Decentraland Support Team via live chat or you can join the official Decentraland Discord server. Please remember that Decentraland staff will never ask you for the private key (seed phrase) to your crypto wallet.

faq_section.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_section.paragraph: Don't see your question below? Check out our full FAQ resources
faq_section.item_0_answer: The first step is downloading the Decentraland app onto your computer at decentraland.org/download. Once installed, log into your Decentraland account by connecting your Google, Discord, or another social profile, or a digital wallet such as MetaMask or Coinbase. Once online verification is complete, open the Decentraland app and click 'Jump Into Decentraland'. From here you can customize your avatar, explore the community-built world, or attend an event and make some friends!
faq_section.item_1_question: Do I need crypto or a digital wallet to use Decentraland?
faq_section.item_1_answer: No, you do not need to own crypto or already have a digital wallet to use Decentraland. Decentraland is free to use, and if you'd like to purchase something from the Marketplace, you can use a credit/debit card in addition to cryptocurrency. If you sign into Decentraland with a social account such as Google or Discord, a digital wallet will be made for your account behind the scenes, so you don't have to worry about anything.
faq_section.item_2_question: What hardware do I need to run Decentraland?
faq_section.item_2_answer: Currently, Decentraland is available for PC on Windows and Mac. For Windows, you'll need at least Windows 10 64-bit, an Intel i5 7th gen or AMD Ryzen 5 CPU, an Nvidia RTX 20 Series or AMD Radeon RX 5000 Series GPU, 6 GB VRAM, 16 GB RAM, and 8 GB storage. For Mac, you'll need at least macOS 11 Big Sur with an Apple M1 chip, 16 GB RAM, and 8 GB storage. Decentraland currently does not run on mobile devices. For full hardware specs, visit docs.decentraland.org/faqs/decentraland-101.
faq_section.item_3_question: How do I explore and navigate Decentraland?
faq_section.item_3_answer: Decentraland consists of Genesis City, an open traversable world made up of community parcels referenced by coordinates, as well as individual Worlds, more intimate 3D spaces that can be teleported into. To explore Genesis City, use your arrow or WASD keys to move around, jump to locations from the map, or type '/goto x,y' in the chat to teleport to specific coordinates. To visit a World, type '/goto WorldName' in the chat.
faq_section.item_4_question: How do I get Wearables, Emotes, LAND, and NAMEs in the Marketplace?
faq_section.item_4_answer: Browse the Marketplace at decentraland.org/marketplace for hundreds of community-made Wearables and Emotes to customize your digital identity, buy or rent Genesis City LAND parcels, or claim your unique NAME which comes with its own World. You can pay by card or with a variety of cryptocurrencies. Anything you purchase is truly owned by you, with ownership registered on the blockchain. You can resell items whenever you wish.
faq_section.item_5_question: How can I meet people in Decentraland?
faq_section.item_5_answer: The best way to meet new people in Decentraland is to attend events and start chatting! Browse the event page at decentraland.org/events for current and upcoming events and don't be shy — Decentraland's community is known for being welcoming. Keep an eye out for weekly tours and meetups, such as ABC DCL - Adventures of Decentraland, which are specifically targeted at new community members!
faq_section.item_6_question: How can I learn about in-world events?
faq_section.item_6_answer: Decentraland's Event Page at decentraland.org/events is the official place where anyone in the community can post their in-world events. To stay on top of events, check the event page regularly, follow Decentraland on social channels such as X, or subscribe to the weekly newsletter at decentraland.beehiiv.com to learn about upcoming activities!
faq_section.item_7_question: How do I take pictures in-world?
faq_section.item_7_answer: Press C on your keyboard to open the Camera. A helpful guide with camera controls will appear on the bottom right of your screen. Your Gallery has space for up to 500 photos, from which you can easily share your images with a link or download them onto your computer. You can feature your favorite photos on your Decentraland Profile by toggling the 'Set as Public' option.
faq_section.item_8_question: How can I get involved in Decentraland governance?
faq_section.item_8_answer: Decentraland's DAO is the heart of the community-driven world's governance. To get started, read through the DAO forums at decentraland.org/governance to learn about current issues, see what the community consensus is, and add your own comments. Learn more on the DAO's official page at decentraland.org/dao.

support_updates_section.title: Support Updates
support_updates_section.item_0_answer:
Backface Culling is now set to On on the engine by default on all model materials.

Why: Significant Performance Optimization.
How: Because it is an engine optimization, it also affects materials that are already published.

Action Points:
We encourage you to check your scenes following the Troubleshooting section in the documentation.

Some scenarios worth checking first:
- Flags, curtains, walls made of Planes: If a wall made of a plane with a single-sided material, it won't be seen from the other side.
- Grass / Leaves of a tree made of Planes with single-sided materials: Same case as above.
- Interior of Cubes and other shapes that act as rooms: If the cube material is facing out, it won't be seen from the inside.
support_updates_section.item_1_answer:
With the focus on the Creator Hub, the Visual Studio Extension is no longer supported.

The Extension has been removed from the VS Marketplace.
support_updates_section.item_2_answer:
Below is a guide on how to find and generate the Player.log file. These files can be helpful when it comes to troubleshooting issues reported.

Open the chat in the Decentraland Desktop app and type: /logs

Or:

For Windows:
Navigate to: C:\Users\{YourUserName}\AppData\LocalLow\Decentraland\Explorer
Find the file named Player.log

For Mac:
Open Finder and press Cmd + Shift + G to open the "Go to Folder" dialog.
Enter the path: /Users/UserName/Library/Logs/Decentraland/Explorer/
Find the file named Player.log

Player.log file would show issues with the current/active session.
Player-prev.log file would show issues with the previous session.

Launcher Logs (output.log):
Windows: C:\Users\username\AppData\Roaming\DecentralandLauncherLight
Mac: /Users/UserName/Library/Logs/DecentralandLauncherLight

delete.danger_description: This action is irreversible. All your data will be permanently deleted.
delete.warning: The following will be lost forever:

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: your username, avatar, bio and display name

marketplace.title: Marketplace activity
marketplace.description: open listings, purchase history and offers

favorites.title: Favorites & history
favorites.description: saved places, recent activity and event RSVPs

notifications.title: Notifications & preferences
notifications.description: all your settings and notification history

delete.asset_warning_description: Deleting your account may cause you to permanently lose access to your on-chain assets (wearables, emotes, LAND, etc). Make sure to export your private key before proceeding.
delete.export_key_description: Go to the Wallets tab and use the wallet manager below your address to export your private key.
delete.export_key_description_magic: Go to the Security tab to view and back up your private key before you delete your account.
delete.acknowledge: I have backed up my private key and I understand that deleting my account is irreversible.

modal.title: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
modal.description: This action is irreversible. All your data will be permanently deleted. To confirm, please type DELETE in the field below and confirm.
modal.generic_error: Failed to delete your account. Please try again later.

delete.unavailable_title: Account deletion isn’t available for this wallet
delete.unavailable_description: Deleting your account only applies to accounts created with email or social login. Self-custodial wallets (like MetaMask or WalletConnect) control their own keys, so there’s nothing to delete here — just disconnect to sign out.

security.title: Private key
security.intro: Your Decentraland account is powered by a self-custodial wallet. Your private key is the master credential that controls this wallet and everything it holds — your MANA, NAMEs, LAND, wearables and emotes.
security.responsibility_description: Backing up your private key lets you access your wallet from any compatible app, and keeps your assets safe if you ever lose access to your login. With self-custody, this responsibility is yours alone.
security.warning_description: Anyone with your private key has full, irreversible control of your account and can move all of your assets. No Decentraland team member will ever ask for it. Store it offline, somewhere only you can reach.
security.reveal_description: You’ll be taken to Magic’s secure reveal page in a new tab to view and back up your private key. You must complete sign-in on the Magic site using the same method you used to sign in to Decentraland.
security.unavailable_title: Security settings aren’t available for this wallet
security.unavailable_description: Revealing a private key only applies to accounts created with email or social login. Self-custodial wallets (like MetaMask or WalletConnect) already manage their own keys, so there’s nothing to reveal here.
